scope: Produce one clean same-store lightweight logical scan with no inherited unknown usage or checkpoint reuse.

frozen_subject.materialization: Create a byte-identical directory copy immediately before execution; fail if the execution source already exists.
frozen_subject.digest_encoding: SHA-256 of a compact UTF-8 JSON array ordered by relative path; each row contains path, file SHA-256, and byte size.

isolation_contract.same_store: Use the current persistent data/repoauditor.db containing terminal protected runs 75 and 90.
isolation_contract.new_identity: The execution source must ingest under a repository identity not used by any existing pipeline run.
isolation_contract.new_root: The fresh foreground pipeline root must have parent_run_id=null.
isolation_contract.no_reuse: Detection must report zero reused completed calls; falsification must begin from the newly ingested identity's own pending queue.
isolation_contract.source_marker: The durable pipeline source retains uat_lightweight_app so usage-calibration recognizes the lightweight role.

planning_basis.qualification: Used only to size the clean run. No prior pipeline, finding, iteration, or model-usage row may be linked or reused.

per_batch_breakers.execution_note: Verify every batch and lower runtime breakers when necessary so remaining aggregate allowances cannot be exceeded.

data_transfer.content: Bounded repository-derived evidence from the byte-identical isolated lightweight snapshot

stop_conditions: The canonical or materialized execution tree digest differs from the frozen digest.
The execution source already exists or resolves to a previously ingested source identity.
The fresh root receives a parent run or any detection checkpoint is reused.
Any provider attempt lacks authoritative usage metadata.
Any batch fails or encounters a transport timeout.
Any aggregate or runtime call, token, dollar, or batch ceiling is reached or would be exceeded.
The isolated lightweight pending queue reaches zero.
excluded: Any protected snapshot execution, tuning, scoring changes, prior-chain repair, deletion of unknown usage, and offline comparison are not authorized.
next_gate: Merge this receipt, then explicitly authorize its exact isolated evidence transfer and ceilings before materializing the alias, reading the keychain, or executing.
